title: Pointed
summary: POINT'ED, participle passive Sharpened; formed to a point; directed; aimed. 1. Aimed at a particular person or transaction. 2. adjective Sharp; having a sharp point; as a pointed rock. 3. Epigrammatic

inlines.v: POINT'ED, participle passive Sharpened; formed to a point; directed; aimed. 1. Aimed at a particular person or transaction. 2. adjective Sharp; having a sharp point; as a pointed rock. 3. Epigrammatical; abounding in conceits or lively turns; as pointed wit.
